instructions:
1. Lie face down with legs straight behind you and hands behind your head, elbows out.
2. Engage your core and glutes.
3. Lift your upper torso off the floor, keeping your neck neutral.
4. Squeeze your lower back at the top for a moment.
5. Lower your torso back down with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your neck neutral and look at the floor.
2. Lift through your lower back, not by yanking with your arms.
3. Use a comfortable, non-slip surface.
4. Start with a small range and build up as you get stronger.

instructions:
1. Lie on your back on a bench with your arms out to the sides, elbows bent 90 degrees.
2. Let your forearms hang off the sides of the bench, pointing down toward the floor.
3. Rotate at your shoulders to lift your forearms up until they point toward the ceiling.
4. Keep the 90-degree elbow angle the whole time.
5. Lower your forearms back down with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your core engaged and back flat on the bench.
2. Move slowly to keep tension on the rotator cuff.
3. Hold the elbow angle fixed at 90 degrees.
4. Use light or no weight to keep the work in the rotator cuff.

instructions:
1. Lie on your back on a bench with your arms out to the sides, elbows bent 90 degrees.
2. Let your forearms hang off the sides of the bench, pointing up toward the ceiling.
3. Rotate at your shoulders to lower your forearms down across your body.
4. Keep the 90-degree elbow angle the whole time.
5. Rotate back to the start position with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your core engaged and back flat on the bench.
2. Move slowly to keep tension on the rotator cuff.
3. Hold the elbow angle fixed at 90 degrees.
4. Use light or no weight to keep the work in the rotator cuff.

instructions:
1. Lie on your back with legs straight and arms out to the sides in a T shape.
2. Bend and lift your right leg, then cross it over your body toward the left side.
3. Reach across with your left hand to gently hold your right knee down.
4. Hold the stretch, feeling it in your lower back, hip, and glute.
5. Return your right leg to the start, then repeat on the other side.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Move slowly and avoid sudden twists.
2. Breathe deeply and steadily as you hold.
3. Do not force your knee to the floor; go only as far as is comfortable.
4. Keep both shoulders on the floor to deepen the twist.

instructions:
1. Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
2. Cross your right ankle over your left thigh, just above the knee, forming a figure-four.
3. Reach through and grasp the back of your left thigh with both hands.
4. Gently pull your left thigh toward your chest until you feel a stretch in your right glute and outer hip.
5. Hold, then release and switch sides. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
2. Pull only to mild tension, never into pain.
3. Use a strap around the thigh if you cannot reach comfortably.
4. Breathe steadily and let the muscle ease into the stretch.
